preamble: The Middle Chinese voiced retroflex stop of the 澄 initial (知 group; Baxter dr-, Zhengzhang and Pulleyblank [ɖ]) became an affricate and devoiced in Mandarin. In the oblique tones (and in the old entering tone) it gave unaspirated [ʈʂ]; in the level tone it gave aspirated [ʈʂʰ], as in 茶 chá and 陳 chén.
